fields.Category: Uncommon magical ammunition · single use · no attunement

fields.Range: The firing bow’s normal range, capped at 60 feet.
fields.Radius and duration: On a hit, ground within 5 feet of the target becomes icy difficult terrain until the end of your next turn.
fields.Crafting: Draft recipe for one arrow: Arcana and Woodcarver’s Tools proficiency, one arrow, and 100 gp of frost-infused materials. Five 8-hour workdays using the 2024 uncommon consumable crafting guideline. The DM determines material availability.
fields.Encounter suggestion: An icy ravine lookout carries two arrows and uses them to slow pursuit across a narrow footbridge.

fields.Activation: Fire from a bow.

fields.Creative use: Keep a fleeing creature within reach while a companion approaches with manacles.

fields.History: The source describes sleep, choke, and fog versions made by Cayma Wokani.

fields.Damage: None in these three utility variants.
fields.Range: 20 ft to a point you can see.
fields.Activation: Take the Utilize action and expend one grenade. Choose its variant when you acquire or create it.
fields.Saving throw: Sleep and choke require a DC 12 Constitution save from breathing creatures in the area. Fog has no save.
fields.Special powers: Sleep: on failure, a creature is Unconscious until the end of its next turn, it takes damage, or another creature within 5 ft takes an action to wake it. Choke: on failure, a creature has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn. Fog: the area is Heavily Obscured until the start of your next turn.
fields.Duration: Until the start of your next turn (fog) or the end of the affected creature’s next turn (sleep or choke).
fields.Crafting: Draft: Alchemist’s Supplies proficiency and access to Cayma recipes at the DM’s discretion; use the 2024 nonmagical crafting guideline.
fields.Creative use: Use fog to break line of sight while an ally retreats.
fields.Attack bonus: No inherent bonus.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses 2024 conditions and a fixed DC. Shortens legacy control to one turn and standardizes the area for a 5-ft grid.

fields.Legacy damage: 2–12 damage, halved by a successful save against spells.
fields.Legacy tracking: A halfling releases it by hand at a creature they can see. It automatically pursues the creature within one round and vanishes when it hits.
fields.Legacy effects: The user can choose damage, immobilization for 2–5 rounds, or both. A silvery glow reveals the target for 3–18 rounds and can be dispelled.
fields.History: Hin Masters and Keepers make the arrows with help from human mages. The Five Shires sheriffs carry them and keep replacement caches.
fields.Source locator: Printed p. 11, PDF p. 12. The Burning Ring is also referenced on printed p. 62.

fields.Category: Rare magic consumable · thrown by hand · one use.
fields.Activation: A halfling holding the arrow takes the Magic action and chooses Strike, Bind, or both. Strike is the default.
fields.Range: One creature you can see within 120 ft. The arrow can turn around obstacles if an open flight path of 120 ft or less reaches it.
fields.Attack bonus: No attack roll. The target makes only the saves required by the selected modes.
fields.Damage: Strike deals 2d6 Force damage, halved on a successful DC 13 Dexterity saving throw.
fields.Saving throw: Strike uses DC 13 Dexterity. Bind uses DC 13 Strength. If you choose both, roll both saves before applying either result.
fields.Special powers: On a failed Bind save, the target is Restrained until the end of its next turn. A creature struck sheds dim silver light in a 5 ft radius and cannot benefit from the Invisible condition while glowing. Dispel Magic can end the glow. The arrow vanishes on impact. If aimed at an illusion, it falls unspent.
fields.Duration: Force damage is immediate. Bind lasts through the target’s next turn. Glow lasts 1 minute without concentration.
fields.Attunement: None; only a halfling can activate it.
fields.Acquisition and encounters: Five Shires sheriff’s issue. A replacement cache or a sheriff’s gift can place one in the party’s hands.
fields.Crafting: The legacy source names the Hin Masters and Keepers as makers. A 2024 recipe and materials are left to the DM.
fields.Creative use: Use Bind to stop a fleeing suspect or mark a creature that can turn Invisible.
fields.Conversion notes: Caps tracking range at 120 ft, uses a fixed DC and Force damage, shortens immobilization, and gives Bind a saving throw.

fields.Legacy damage: Iron rod with a +2 bonus and 2–8 damage.
fields.Legacy power: Can hold one person by touch in place of dealing damage. The legacy effect lasts 2–5 rounds.

fields.Category: Rare magic rod · simple melee weapon · requires attunement.
fields.Activation: Attack with the rod using the Attack action. Once per Long Rest, you may take a Magic action to touch a Humanoid and cast Hold Person from the rod instead.

fields.Attack bonus: +2 to attack rolls made with the rod, in addition to the normal attack modifiers.
fields.Range: 5 ft melee reach. Hold Person from this rod has a range of touch.
fields.Mastery: Slow, if you can use this weapon’s mastery.
fields.Saving throw: DC 15 Wisdom for Hold Person. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on a success.
fields.Duration: Hold Person lasts up to 1 minute with concentration.
fields.Creative use: Subdue a suspect within reach while the party secures the exits.
fields.Conversion notes: Keeps the +2 weapon and touch-only restraint, uses the 2024 Hold Person spell with a fixed save DC, and adds a per-rest limit.

fields.Range: One creature you can see within 15 ft.
fields.Activation: Replace one attack during the Attack action to throw the net. Resolve a saving throw.
fields.Escape: A Restrained creature or a creature within 5 ft of it can use an action to free it on a successful DC 10 Strength (Athletics) check. Destroying the net also frees it.
fields.Net defenses: AC 10, 5 HP. Immune to Bludgeoning, Poison, and Psychic damage.
fields.Damage: On a failed save, deal 2d6 Slashing once, when the net lands. No recurring damage.
fields.Saving throw: Dexterity DC = 8 + your Dexterity modifier + proficiency bonus. Huge or larger creatures succeed automatically. On failure the target takes the damage and is Restrained until freed.
fields.Conversion notes: The 2024 Net uses a save instead of a weapon attack. This conversion uses the failed save as the trigger for a single damaging hit, inspired by the 2024 Vicious Weapon’s 2d6 rider. Slashing represents cutting fibers.

fields.Damage: 1d6 Piercing. Maximize the weapon damage dice on a hit against an object. A natural 20 on an attack against a creature adds 14 Slashing.
fields.Activation: Use normal Shortsword attacks. Apply the object or natural-20 effect when triggered.
fields.Special powers: A creature affected by the natural-20 rider also gains 1 level of Exhaustion.
fields.Conversion notes: Extends the 2024 enchantment to the legacy Shortsword. Base damage remains Piercing. The enchantment’s extra damage is Slashing.

fields.Damage: 1d6 Piercing plus 3. On a qualifying natural 20, sever a head or deal 30 extra Slashing as described below.
fields.Attack bonus: +3 to attack and damage rolls.
fields.Activation: When you roll a natural 20 on an attack against a creature with at least one head, sever one head. It dies if it needs that head to survive.
fields.Exceptions: A target immune to Slashing, one that does not need its head, or one the DM judges too large to decapitate instead takes the 30 extra Slashing. A target with Legendary Resistance can expend one use to take the extra damage instead. Normal damage immunities still apply.
fields.Special powers: Ignore Slashing Resistance for the enchantment’s extra damage. The normal Piercing damage uses the target’s normal defenses.
fields.Conversion notes: Extends the 2024 enchantment to the legacy Shortsword while retaining its Piercing base.
